summary: Iteration 165 - Merchant Platform V5 (Enterprise Dashboard + Executive AI) VERIFIED. All new features working correctly. Backend endpoints return structured data without MongoDB ObjectId serialization errors. Frontend tabs render properly with all KPIs, forecasts, and AI-generated briefings.

issues: Minor: Revenue Growth shows -100.0% which is technically correct but could be confusing for new merchants with no sales data

tests: GET /api/merchant-portal/v5/dashboard - PASS (200 OK, returns executive_overview, financials, merchant_kpis, insights)
GET /api/merchant-portal/v5/executive-ai/latest - PASS (200 OK, returns report and history)
POST /api/merchant-portal/v5/executive-ai/stream - PASS (200 OK, streams AI-generated content with provider=openai)
Click Enterprise V5 tab - PASS (merchant-v5-dashboard container loads)
Click Executive AI tab - PASS (merchant-v5-executive-ai container loads)
Run Executive Briefing - PASS (2539 chars output with Executive Summary, Revenue Insights, Inventory Insights, Staff Insights, Sales Forecasts)

enterprise_v5_dashboard.details: Enterprise Dashboard shows Revenue, Profit, Branches, Inventory, POS, Staff, Wallet, and Merchant KPIs. Executive Overview section displays growth metrics. Executive Summary bullet points render correctly.

executive_ai_tab.details: Executive AI tab shows focus input, run button, Sales Forecast card, Purchase Recommendations card, and History. AI briefing generates successfully with streaming output.

v5_dashboard_api.details: GET /api/merchant-portal/v5/dashboard returns structured data with executive_overview, financials, merchant_kpis, insights (revenue, inventory, staff, sales_forecast, purchase_recommendations, business_alerts, executive_summary)

executive_ai_latest_api.details: GET /api/merchant-portal/v5/executive-ai/latest returns report object and history array

executive_ai_stream_api.details: POST /api/merchant-portal/v5/executive-ai/stream streams AI-generated content with provider=openai, saves report to merchant_executive_ai_reports collection

critical_code_review_comments: Backend _build_enterprise_overview_data helper correctly aggregates data from multiple collections (pos_merchants, pos_stores, pos_registers, pos_products, pos_sales, staff_members, etc.)
Executive AI fallback logic works correctly - falls back to rules-based report if LLM fails
Frontend correctly uses data-testid attributes for all interactive elements
No MongoDB ObjectId serialization errors - all _id fields properly excluded with {'_id': 0}
seed_data_creation: None - used existing seeded admin account and POS merchant data
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 165 verified the new Merchant Platform V5 features. Enterprise V5 Dashboard shows comprehensive KPIs for Revenue, Profit, Branches, Inventory, POS, Staff, Wallet. Executive AI tab generates AI-powered briefings with Revenue Insights, Inventory Insights, Staff Insights, Sales Forecasts, Purchase Recommendations, and Business Alerts.
